cases.before_name: a captured tap cannot act after photo count changes
cases.current_name: a captured tap cannot act after photo count changes
cases.reason: Three tests retain no-feedback requirements: captured tap callback after same-owner photo-source or photo-count replacement emits one tick, and a tap invoked during a finger swipe emits one while _showPhoto deliberately rejects navigation. The outer recognizer/wrapper remains installed, but its inner authority/scroll guard rejects the action. HAPTICS §2 says enabled taps tick and disabled controls/swipes do not; it does not explicitly resolve whether these rejected callbacks are enabled taps or disabled/ignored controls. Do not change zero to one solely to match the implementation.
authorities: PRODUCT/APPROVED/HAPTICS/BRIEFS/HAPTICS_BRIEF_2026-10-30.md §2–3; Founder-named behavior rule, no new master
